title: The Most Important Assignment in Life is Love

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Hovered over the treating doctor and later into his home while the doctor was in bed.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'wonderful and light' with no pain; later described return as like being 'strapped in a straight-jacket' after moving freely.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Later said they were 'sent back through the same tunnel' and 'kind of pulled back' when told it was not the right time.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Flew over a figure of Christ with open arms; later felt a loving being behind the left shoulder and 'think it was Jesus.'
arrival.other_being_detail: A loving, non-visible presence beside/behind them that supported them and showed what they had to return to.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful meadow with flowers; colors 'fantastic' and unlike earthly colors; peaceful place.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told telepathically it was 'not the right time'; shown that they 'had to return to earth in order to finish quite a lot' and 'sow love' to reap later.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Pulled back; later 'sent back through the same tunnel' and returned to the hospital room/body under the ceiling.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Return to finish their course of life, improve as a human being, and 'first and foremost' sow love; avoid judging others; send loving thoughts.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hospital examination involving needle insertion into the nape; accidental injury to central nervous system; became abnormal pulse and prolonged unconsciousness.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Grew up in a family of non-believers.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Said they 'always felt Jesus in my heart.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Past-life 'clips'; portal/arch where they perceived the 'meaning of life'; clairvoyant/empathetic aftereffects.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (including earth-bound hovering and remote visit) → tunnel → brilliant light → peaceful meadow with deceased → telepathic 'not the right time' → portal/meaning-of-life → past-life clips → life review with loving being → shown need to return → back through tunnel → return to body with resistance and pain.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Tunnel was traversed going out and again on return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: After return felt 'split into two persons'—in-body pain while spiritual experiences remained vividly present.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Extended sequence of 'movie clips' including a portal/arch ('arch of life') revealing the meaning of life (not retained), and multiple past-life scenes including violent death (beheading) and war-related trauma.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The earth is like a film that hasn’t been developed. Not until we reach the other side is the film developed...”; “It was said telepathically to me that it was not the right time.”; “It just supported me and gave me love.”; “The most important assignment in life is love.”
